name: Zig and Sharko
description: On a desert island lives a starving hyena with one obsession: devour that delicious mermaid from the rock in the lagoon. But the lovely fish-girl’s best friend is a shark, a shark with a lot of muscle and who loves to sabotage the hyena’s every move.

videos.title: Fishy Story
videos.overview: Zig, a hyena living on an island, decides to eat the lovely mermaid, Marina, but Sharko, a strong shark, keeps blocking Zig's path.

videos.title: Desert Island Drought
videos.overview: King Neptune tries to woo Marina, so Zig and Sharko must work together to bring her back.

videos.title: King Neptune's Court
videos.overview: An oil spill makes the ocean slick and slimy, so Bernie finds a way to get rid of all the oil in the water.

videos.title: The Slick
videos.overview: An oil spill makes the ocean slick and slimy, so Bernie finds a way to get rid of all the oil in the water.

videos.title: Treasure Island Tricks
videos.overview: Sharko discovers a buried treasure and builds a luxury mansion, then must deal with the treasure's angry pirate owner.

videos.title: Cold Snap
videos.overview: Zig battles a polar bear after the water freezes.

videos.title: Mermaid's Pup
videos.overview: Marina wants a pet, so she adopts Bernie and treats him like a pet.

videos.title: Work in Progress
videos.overview: Zig helps Sharko rebuild Marina's house after it is destroyed.

videos.title: Cruising
videos.overview: Zig builds some ships in order to eat Marina.

videos.title: The Mermaid in the Sky
videos.overview: Marina dreams of being a flight attendant.

videos.title: A Lovesick Survivor
videos.overview: Zig and Sharko join forces against a human castaway competing for Marina's affections.

videos.title: Digging Deep
videos.overview: Zig finds interesting objects while digging a tunnel in his latest scheme to catch Marina.

videos.title: Waterski Hit
videos.overview: Marina takes up water skiing using Sharko as her "boat"; Zig enlists a crazy dolphin's help to catch her.

videos.title: Nurse Marina
videos.overview: Marina nurses Zig back to health after one of Sharko's beatings.

videos.title: Hundreds of Kids and Counting
videos.overview: Bernie becomes a surrogate father to a lost herd of baby crabs.

videos.title: The Submarine
videos.overview: Zig and Bernie disguise an old submarine as a female shark to lure Sharko away from Marina.

videos.title: A Tale of Two Legs
videos.overview: Zig and Bernie discover a mannequin on the island, while Marina discovers something much more profound.

videos.title: Little Shrimp Buddy
videos.overview: A shrimp competes with Bernie as Zig's assistant.

videos.title: The Horribly Hungry Hyena
videos.overview: Zig tries to sabotage Sharko and Marina's dinner date.

videos.title: Volcano Turbo
videos.overview: Zig tries using the active volcano against Marina.

videos.title: Lighthouse
videos.overview: A lighthouse is put up near the island after a fog roll in.

videos.title: Bamboozled
videos.overview: Zig finds a wrecked boat on the shore and uses its cargo of bamboo in his latest scheme.

videos.title: Blown Up!
videos.overview: Zig uses inflatable balloons to get to Marina.

videos.title: Silly Builders
videos.overview: Zig builds a boat out of LEGO-like building blocks to catch Marina.

videos.title: The Manic Mermaid
videos.overview: Marina has to compete with another mermaid for Sharko's affections.

videos.title: Aqua Golf
videos.overview: Zig attempts to catch Marina while she plays golf with Sharko.

videos.title: The Island Tour
videos.overview: Zig holds a go-cart race to catch Marina.

videos.title: Moby Zig
videos.overview: Zig enlists several whales in his schemes.

videos.title: Santa Zig
videos.overview: Zig dresses up as Santa Claus to catch Marina.

videos.title: Saving Mermaid Marina
videos.overview: After Sharko rescues Marina trapped in Zig's swimming pool, they find his lair.

videos.title: Silly Sleight of Hand
videos.overview: Zig and Bernie find a magician's powerful hat and cane.

videos.title: Hammerhead Cousin
videos.overview: Sharko leaves temporally with a hammerhead shark.

videos.title: Sharko Hunting
videos.overview: A Japanese whaling ship tries to capture Sharko.

videos.title: The Challengers
videos.overview: A manta ray competes for Marina's affections.

videos.title: Birthday Party
videos.overview: Zig throws Marina a birthday party to trap her; she is angry at Sharko for forgetting her birthday.

videos.title: The Coach
videos.overview: A jaguar shows up on the island and tries to coach Zig into becoming buff.

videos.title: Frozen Island
videos.overview: Sharko turns the volcano into a ski resort so that Marina can try out some winter sports.

videos.title: At Your Service
videos.overview: Zig becomes Marina's butler in an attempt to catch her.

videos.title: Freedom for Marina!
videos.overview: Zig and Sharko must join forces to rescue Marina, who is being taken to an aquarium.

videos.title: Marina's New Friend
videos.overview: Sharko dresses Zig as a mermaid and forces him to become Marina's companion.

videos.title: The Fan
videos.overview: A piranha befriends Sharko and Marina but actually intends to eat her.

videos.title: The Ghastly Ghost
videos.overview: Marina becomes friends with a ghost who shows up at her house, to Sharko's dismay.

videos.title: Sea's Up
videos.overview: A tsunami floods the island, and Marina temporarily loses Sharko.

videos.title: Fairground Follies!
videos.overview: Zig and Bernie build an amusement park to trap Marina.

videos.title: Zig's Jumbo Friend
videos.overview: Zig finds an elephant in a crate washed up on shore and tries to use it in his schemes.

videos.title: Bottom's Bottom
videos.overview: Zig and Sharko find a strange and mysterious place at the bottom of the sea.

videos.title: Babysitting
videos.overview: Marina babysits a baby octopus.

videos.title: Caution, Genius at Work!
videos.overview: Zig finds a book of Da Vinci's inventions and tries to use them in his schemes.

videos.title: Goin' Home
videos.overview: Zig returns to Africa to live among his fellow hyenas but finds he doesn't fit in.

videos.title: Sharko and His Folks
videos.overview: Sharko's parents visit; they disapprove of his relationship with a mermaid.

videos.title: Camping Calamity
videos.overview: Marina and Sharko go camping, but Zig and Bernie aren't far behind.

videos.title: Magical Jellyfish
videos.overview: Zig uses a shapeshifting jellyfish that washes up on shore in his latest scheme.

videos.title: Boo... Who!
videos.overview: Zig volunteers to help rid Sharko's hiccups, as another scheme to get Marina.

videos.title: Super Zig
videos.overview: Inspired by a TV show, Zig emulates a superhero to trap Marina.

videos.title: The Tiny Tyrant
videos.overview: Bernie makes a strength potion to take over King Neptune's castle.

videos.title: Coral Reef Cowboys
videos.overview: Zig gets knocked unconscious, and dreams he is in a Western.

videos.title: The King's Highway
videos.overview: Neptune wants to build a road to his tennis court, through Marina and Sharko's house.

videos.title: Fancy Footwork
videos.overview: A "fishy godmother" grants Marina's wish for legs, but it causes more problems than it solves.

videos.title: Origami
videos.overview: Zig and Bernie find a variety of origami creations from a wrecked cargo ship and use them in their schemes.

videos.title: Me, Myself and I
videos.overview: The shock of an electric eel causes Zig and Sharko to switch bodies.

videos.title: War of the Clones
videos.overview: Bernie makes robot clones of Zig to get Marina, but they can't be controlled.

videos.title: Save the Hyena!
videos.overview: When Marina becomes a lifeguard, Zig pretends to drown to trap her.

videos.title: Bristlebeard's Adventure
videos.overview: A band of pirates tries to capture Marina.

videos.title: The Noble Knight of the Lagoon
videos.overview: Zig challenges Sharko to a jousting duel.

videos.title: Troublemakers
videos.overview: Troublemakers

videos.title: Marina Superstar
videos.overview: King Neptune makes Marina a singing star; Sharko must team up with Zig to get her back.

videos.title: The Were-Yena
videos.overview: Eating bananas causes Zig to transform into a Jekyll and Hyde monster.

videos.title: Loony Cruise
videos.overview: When a cruise ship visits the island, Marina and Sharko pose as passengers, pursued by Zig.

videos.title: Lightning Love
videos.overview: Zig gets amnesia and reverts to a baby after getting struck by lightning.

videos.title: Bernie Moves House
videos.overview: Bernie moves away from the island after a bitter argument with Zig and invites Sharko and Marina to a house party.

videos.title: Hair Story
videos.overview: Sharko tries to fix Marina's bad haircut before taking her to the opera.

videos.title: Space Fruits
videos.overview: Extraterrestrial fruit juices give Zig and Sharko strange powers.

videos.title: Zig Taxi-Driver
videos.overview: Zig takes advantage of Marina's shopping addiction by posing as a cab driver.

videos.title: Cop Duty
videos.overview: Marina convinces Sharko to join the police force.

videos.title: Goofy Astronauts
videos.overview: Marina, Sharko, Zig, and Bernie find a rocket and are accidentally shot into orbit, where they meet a deranged astronaut on a space station.

videos.title: Fisherman's Catch
videos.overview: A fisherman arrives at the island and starts kidnapping undersea life to catch scallops.

videos.title: The Return of the Crazy Dolphin
videos.overview: When Zig gives up trying to catch Marina, Bernie gets the crazy dolphin to lure her to the island.

videos.title: Toys Attack!
videos.overview: A shipwrecked boat carries toys, which Zig employs in his schemes. The last episode of season 1 with the old designs.

videos.title: What a Day
videos.overview: Zig can't believe his luck when Marina decides to live on the beach in a sandcastle built by Sharko. zig and sharko get redesigns in this episode.

videos.title: Beach Hero
videos.overview: Zig suddenly becomes popular and pretends to be a hero.

videos.title: Back to Civilization
videos.overview: Marina tries to re-educate the looney pilot living in the wrecked plane with Zig and Bernie.

videos.title: Father in Law
videos.overview: Sharko tries to impress Marina's father, King Poseidon.

videos.title: Stuffed Animals
videos.overview: Zig becomes the playmate of a baby dolphin, who mistakes him for its lost doll.

videos.title: Zig Airlines
videos.overview: Zig and Bernie trick Marina and Sharko into thinking the wrecked plane can fly, and take them for a "ride".

videos.title: Castle Life
videos.overview: Zig and Bernie get a taste of the good life when Marina invites them to live in her sandcastle.

videos.title: Mermaid Fritter
videos.overview: Bernie tricks Zig into thinking he has succeeded in killing and eating Marina. Deprived of his life's purpose, Zig sinks into depression.

videos.title: A Mysterious Guest
videos.overview: Zig lures Marina and Sharko into the jungle by telling them the pilot has been bitten by a koala.

videos.title: End of the World
videos.overview: Everyone panics when a giant meteor heads for the island.

videos.title: Let's Dance!!
videos.overview: Zig and Bernie throw a dance party to catch Marina.

videos.title: Sea, Surf and Fun
videos.overview: Marina takes up surfing; Bernie steals Poseidon's trident so Zig can surf on huge waves.

videos.title: Bad Hair Day
videos.overview: Zig disguises himself with a false mustache after getting himself banned from the island, but doesn't fool Sharko; Sharko similarly uses a wig after getting himself banned for beating up the "new guest".

videos.title: Fishing For Hyenas
videos.overview: A fisherman comes to the island and tries to capture Zig.

videos.title: Run Sharko, Run!
videos.overview: Marina gives Sharko a pair of running shoes for a race, but they don't fit; Zig finds them and uses them to catch Marina.

videos.title: The Conquistador
videos.overview: A conquistador comes to the island and tries to take Marina for an aquarium display.

videos.title: Game Over Not!
videos.overview: A pod of orcas challenge Zig, Sharko, and Bernie to a game of rugby football.

videos.title: Spick and Span
videos.overview: Sharko finds it's cleaning day in Marina's sandcastle; Zig and Bernie offer to "help".

videos.title: A Whistle for Sharko
videos.overview: Zig gives Sharko a whistle to distract him; Sharko takes his lifeguard job a little too seriously.

videos.title: Bionic Zig
videos.overview: Bernie turns Zig into a cyborg after a Sharko beatdown.

videos.title: Sharko and Zig on the Rocks
videos.overview: Sharko and Zig open up a juice bar on the beach.

videos.title: The Master of the Volcano
videos.overview: Zig discovers Hades, the god of death, lives inside the volcano, and has fallen in love with Marina.

videos.title: Let's Get Fit!
videos.overview: Marina discovers Sharko is gaining weight, so Zig and Bernie turn her sandcastle into a spa.

videos.title: It's Magic!
videos.overview: Zig becomes a magician to capture Marina but finds his magic is no match for Sharko's.

videos.title: A Sweet Tooth
videos.overview: When Marina becomes obsessed with candy, Zig uses it as bait; Sharko tries to get her to eat healthily.

videos.title: The Scent of the Hyena
videos.overview: Bernie invents a deodorant that makes Zig irresistible to Marina; unfortunately it has the same effect on Sharko and everyone else (including Zig himself).

videos.title: Bodyguard
videos.overview: When a masked assailant sprays everyone with black ink, Marina insists Zig be her bodyguard.

videos.title: Self-Defense Academy
videos.overview: Three mermaids come to visit Marina; Sharko gives the four of them martial arts self-defense lessons.

videos.title: A Generous Mermaid
videos.overview: Zig discovers Marina is not afraid of him – at all.

videos.title: Catch a Falling Star
videos.overview: Marina loses the starfish she wears in her hair; Bernie finds it and falls madly in love with it.

videos.title: Lousy Beach Drivers
videos.overview: Sharko gets a sports car for a hot date with Marina, but she is more interested in the car.

videos.title: A Relative Problem
videos.overview: Zig's cousins come to visit him on the island; they find Marina appetizing too.

videos.title: King of the Animal World
videos.overview: A pair of giant lizards show up and become Zig's bodyguards, but their secret agenda is to get rich making toy replicas of him.

videos.title: Bosom Buddies
videos.overview: Zig remembers how he and Bernie were adopted as babies by a mother gorilla.

videos.title: Tourists
videos.overview: Marina attracts a couple of human tourists with her singing; she must disguise Sharko as a kitty cat so they aren't afraid of him.

videos.title: Teacher's Pet
videos.overview: Marina decides to teach school to the island kids; Zig enrolls as a student.

videos.title: Rolling, Action!
videos.overview: Bernie decides to film a Zig and Sharko movie, casting Marina and Zig as themselves but not Sharko, until he has to fire the other shark.

videos.title: Buzzing Around
videos.overview: Marina's relaxation is ruined by a housefly.

videos.title: Unicorn Blues
videos.overview: A unicorn shows up on the island; Zig and Bernie steal its magic horn to catch Marina.

videos.title: Tinky Toys
videos.overview: Zig finds a size-changing ray gun and tries to use it to get rid of Sharko.

videos.title: The Invader
videos.overview: An extraterrestrial lands on the island and impersonates Bernie, to catch Marina.

videos.title: Daddy Dearest
videos.overview: Marina commands Sharko to brood an unhatched egg.

videos.title: Lost in the Woods
videos.overview: Zig and Sharko get lost in the jungle and must work together to find their way out.

videos.title: Daddy's Little Doggy
videos.overview: Marina and Sharko turn Zig into their pet dog.

videos.title: Marina Goes Farming
videos.overview: Marina decides to grow silkworms; Zig disguises himself as a giant one, which doesn't fool Sharko.

videos.title: Hair Do, Hair Don't
videos.overview: When Marina's hair cream makes her hair grow super long overnight, Zig offers to help her fix it.

videos.title: High on the Mountain Top
videos.overview: When a freak snowfall covers the volcano, Marina decides to go mountain climbing.

videos.title: The Mummy
videos.overview: Marina discovers a pyramid with an apparently friendly mummy inside.

videos.title: Movie Night
videos.overview: Sharko visits Marina's sandcastle to watch a movie with her; everyone else on the island wants to watch it too.

videos.title: That Sinking Feeling
videos.overview: During a chase, Zig, Sharko and Marina sink into the earth’s depths. For Marina, it’s the chance to recall a childhood experience. For Sharko, it’s a total freak-out, and for Zig? An unusual setting for a great meal!

videos.title: Teen Rebels
videos.overview: Zig remembers when he, Bernie, Sharko, and Marina were all teenagers.

videos.title: The Moo Can
videos.overview: Marina becomes obsessed with a moo box. Zig and Bernie use it as a trap, but Sharko wants it for himself.

videos.title: The Heist
videos.overview: Zig and Bernie try to steal Marina's necklace.

videos.title: An Evil Panda
videos.overview: Hades transforms himself into a panda bear to win Marina's heart.

videos.title: Playtime
videos.overview: Zig, Sharko, and Bernie remember when they used to play pirates as kids, and they first met Marina.

videos.title: LOL Zig
videos.overview: Marina posts a viral video of Zig with pizza all over his face.

videos.title: High Wired
videos.overview: Marina wants to set a world record for the longest tightrope-walk. Zig takes advantage when he realizes Sharko is afraid of heights.

videos.title: A Three-Pronged Disaster
videos.overview: Marina thinks Poseidon is giving her a magic trident for her birthday, but he gives her a toy fish instead. So she steals his trident while he's asleep.

videos.title: Boing! Boing!
videos.overview: When a cargo of trampolines falls on the island, Zig uses them to try to catch Marina.

videos.title: Little Train, Big Adventure
videos.overview: When Marina takes an interest in toy trains, Zig and Bernie offer to give her a ride on a miniature train.

videos.title: Red light, Greenlight
videos.overview: Marina plays "Red Light, Green Light" with the boys.

videos.title: The Fall
videos.overview: Zig uses a human cannon-ball stunt to blast Marina to the wrecked plane, but it blasts them and Sharko into space and back to Earth.

videos.title: Zig Top Chef
videos.overview: Sharko has a cooking competition with Zig to win Marina's affections.

videos.title: Miss Beach
videos.overview: Sharko convinces Marina to enter a beauty contest on the beach.

videos.title: Catch You on the Rewind
videos.overview: When Zig succeeds in eating Marina, Sharko steals Hades' universal remote to rewind time and prevent it.

videos.title: Dance of the Vampire
videos.overview: When Zig dresses up as a vampire to catch Marina, she and Sharko are freaked out after watching a horror movie.

videos.title: Front Runner
videos.overview: Zig tries using two ponies that arrive on the island to get Marina, but they are really slow.

videos.title: The Power of Attraction
videos.overview: When a crate of magnets lands on the island, Bernie makes Marina a magnet necklace to capture her.

videos.title: Choice Morsels
videos.overview: Zig uses a matter transporter which lands on the island to try to catch Marina.

videos.title: Bubble-Gum
videos.overview: Sharko's romantic plans are thwarted when Marina finds a crate of bubblegum and wants to break the world's largest bubble record.

videos.title: Veggie Zig
videos.overview: Bernie hypnotizes Zig to become a vegetarian; Marina finds him amusing and hangs out with him, making Sharko jealous.

videos.title: The Curse
videos.overview: The mummy places a curse on Zig.

videos.title: DIY Sharko & Invisible Zig
videos.overview: Zig is covered with glue and sand while the shark is trying to repair the sandcastle.

videos.title: Game, Set, and Match
videos.overview: After Sharko defeats Marina at ping-pong, Zig challenges him to a crooked game of tennis, as a ploy to catch her.

videos.title: Heat Wave
videos.overview: A broken boiler wreaks havoc.

videos.title: The Proposal
videos.overview: Sharko plans on proposing to Marina, but Zig keeps ruining the moment by stealing the ring.

videos.title: Disco in the Dark
videos.overview: Zig finds a button that turns everything dark and opens a discoteque to trap Marina.

videos.title: The Toothpaste
videos.overview: While Sharko is sleeping, Zig puts stinky cheese into his mouth; Sharko uses toothpaste to fix it.

videos.title: Welcome on Board
videos.overview: Marina dreams of sailing the sea, so Zig asks Bernie to build a cruise ship where all her friends can hop aboard! However, all awhile, Sharko believes this cruise vacation is another one of Zig's traps. When the boat is taking a dangerous course, Zig and Sharko are too busy bickering as always to save the day… who will come to the rescue?

videos.title: Daddy Cool
videos.overview: Zig dresses up as a cute baby so that Marina takes care of him. But the mermaid is too busy and asks Sharko to babysit Zig! The shark develops strong paternal feelings towards the kid and is heartbroken when he finds out his true identity.

videos.title: Nurse Marina
videos.overview: Marina replaces the ship's nurse for the day, so Zig pretends to be hurt to be alone with her in the infirmary, but Sharko is not fooled and does the same thing.

videos.title: Safety First
videos.overview: When the emergency alarm rings by mistake, everyone panics! Sharko decides to organize safety training to protect everyone in case of an emergency. But Marina isn’t a very serious student, and Zig sabotages the classes to seize the mermaid.

videos.title: The Storm
videos.overview: When a huge thunderstorm forces everyone to go inside the ship, Zig takes advantage of Sharko's seasickness to catch Marina whenever she has to save passengers that got stuck outside.

videos.title: The Treasure Hunt
videos.overview: Zig sends Marina and Sharko on a fake treasure hunt in order to catch the mermaid, but they end up discovering a real abandoned galleon with cursed treasure inside.

videos.title: Sharko My Hero
videos.overview: The baby swordfish starts idolizing Sharko to the point of repeating his every move, much to the shark's embarrassment.

videos.title: Under the Sea
videos.overview: When the ship sinks underwater, Sharko tries to take the opportunity to kill some nostalgic memories of swimming in the ocean, but Marina forces him to help her fix the boat instead.

videos.title: Do Not Disturb
videos.overview: Zig tries to eat Marina at night while she's sleeping, so Sharko must save her without making too much noise, as she gets extremely angry when woken up.

videos.title: Blindman's Bluff
videos.overview: Sharko must stop Marina from being lured into Zig's stomach during a game of blind man's buff.

videos.title: Zig the Gardener
videos.overview: After accidentally tossing Sharko's fertilizer in the ocean, Marina creates a new one that makes all the plants in his garden grow huge. However, when Bernie's small carnivorous plant drinks an entire bottle of the substance, it turns into a giant monster.

videos.title: Garbage Galore
videos.overview: The ocean liner makes a stop off a magnificent desert island. When Sharko turns the beautiful beach into a garbage dump, Marina orders him to clean it up. Of course, Zig and Bernie turn his task into a nightmare to keep the shark busy.

videos.title: Freezing Buddies
videos.overview: After a high-speed chase across the ship, Zig and Sharko get stuck inside the kitchen’s cold room. The shark and the hyena will soon have to forget their differences and combine forces to find a way out of this tricky situation...

videos.title: Frosty Friendship
videos.overview: After the ship crashes into an iceberg, Marina decides to explore it and befriends a penguin living there. However, once the ship is repaired, the creepy little bird refuses to let her or Sharko leave.

videos.title: The Maze
videos.overview: Zig, Bernie, Sharko and Marina land in a labyrinth of corridors and pipes in the engine room. While Sharko tries to find the exit, Zig tries to grab Marina every time he is not looking.

videos.title: The Parsley
videos.overview: Marina gets a piece of parsley stuck in-between her teeth, but she does not notice it, even after Sharko tries to explain it to her. This causes the shark and the other cruisers to run away from her in disgust, except for Zig, who takes advantage of the situation in order to eat her.

videos.title: Viking Love
videos.overview: Olga-the-terrible, a Viking chieftain has fallen head over heels in love with Zig. He is quite happy to have her shield him against Sharko, but not so happy with the fact that she keeps him away from Marina who Olga sees as a rival…

videos.title: Hide and Squeak
videos.overview: Marina and Sharko are playing hide and seek, but the mermaid is not very good at hiding. However, she eventually finds a spot so good that neither the shark or Zig can find her, no matter how hard they look.

videos.title: The Invaders
videos.overview: Rats invade the boat! Marina tries to get rid of them and Sharko would like to help, but he is terrified by the rodents… Zig and Bernie will use his weakness to their advantage. Will Sharko be able to overcome his phobia to save Marina?

videos.title: The Pranksters
videos.overview: Sharko can’t stand gags and pranks, so Marina teams up with Zig and Bernie to loosen him up. But they take advantage and double-up their gags to overpower the shark. Is Sharko the only one who doesn’t have a sense of humor?

videos.title: Synchronized Swimming
videos.overview: Sharko has a secret passion for synchronized swimming! Marina decides to make him the star of the swimming pool. Zig finds him absolutely ridiculous… and is very pleased to discover that mockery can be a powerful weapon against the shark!

videos.title: Spotless
videos.overview: Sharko's romantic dinner with Marina keeps getting interrupted by Bernie and Zig's constant attempts to smudge his fancy suit.

videos.title: Old Buddies
videos.overview: Sharko is happy to be reunited with two old friends from his teenage years, but Marina isn't very fond of their rebellious ways.

videos.title: A Hell of a Friend
videos.overview: Hades visits the ship in order to finally get a kiss from Marina, but she could be more horrified of him.

videos.title: Robot Craze
videos.overview: Marina has a new obsession: giant robots! This gives Zig an idea, maybe he could defeat Sharko with the right armor. But Sharko has no trouble beating up Zig-Robot… until the hyena shows up in a real giant robot.

videos.title: Bionic Butler
videos.overview: Marina and Sharko wanted to buy a dinner robot and Zig had an idea to eat to make Bernie a robot and his income but the real dinner robot came and his Zig vacation unintentionally began to crash.

videos.title: Grounded!
videos.overview: Sharko and the animals are thirsty and around the world the water does not exist and marina checks for one of its free, Zig and Bernie to give water in the mold to eat marina.

videos.title: The Kiss
videos.overview: Marina reads a fairytale about a frog changing into Prince Charming after being kissed and totally believes in it. Zig takes advantage of her gullibility to attract her into various traps, but he mainly attracts Sharko’s jealousy and rage.

videos.title: A Beautiful Shell
videos.overview: This morning Bernie's day, but he is too small to care for him returned Zig Bernie back to the hopper to the ground and broke his helmet and saw the colored animal was Zig and Marina and Sharko much loved him and gave him the idea Bernie to love.

videos.title: The Song of the Sirens
videos.overview: When the ocean liner passes off Siren Island, Sharko is drawn to the evil sirens. Fortunately, Marina is there to save him...

videos.title: Hats Off to the Artist
videos.overview: Bernie organizes a painting workshop to allow Zig to approach Marina. Sharko joins them to keep an eye on the hyena. Marina is happy to be with her friends but is quickly frustrated to discover that they draw better than her...

videos.title: A Star on Board
videos.overview: A famous actor of which Sharko and Marina are fans comes to stay on the boat. When Zig discovers that the star is wearing a mask that makes him beautiful and strong, he intends to use it to attract and eat the mermaid...

videos.title: Operation Santa Claus
videos.overview: It’s Christmas! Zig dresses up as Santa Claus, but Sharko is no fool. However, he himself has to dress the part to replace the hyena after ejecting him into orbit. He’d rather keep an eye on Marina than play Santa!

videos.title: The Mermaid's Feast
videos.overview: Sharko wants to offer Marina a romantic dinner in the boat’s restaurant but has to keep a close eye on Zig to prevent the mermaid from becoming the main course. Meanwhile, Marina is hungry, in fact so hungry she could eat a hyena…

videos.title: Atchoo!
videos.overview: When Marina starts taking care of a baby seagull, Sharko discovers that he's allergic to feathers! Of course, Zig makes the most of the shark's weakness. He feathers the little gull to keep Sharko away from the mermaid to savor her!

videos.title: Virtual Attraction
videos.overview: Marina is addicted to a VR game and she completely ignores Sharko. Zig is going to try and take advantage of the situation. And when the shark tries to rescue his mermaid, it’s he who gets trapped in the VR headset …

videos.title: Rockstar Marina
videos.overview: Marina decides to set up a rock group and enlists her friends. During rehearsals Sharko turns out to be a very bad musician and gets kicked out of the group. But with the involuntary help of Zig, he will reveal his true talent during the concert!

videos.title: The Fitness Session
videos.overview: Marina is eager to exercise and signs up for fitness training. Of course, Zig conspires to take on the role of a fitness coach to move in on Marina… and to beat Sharko on his own turf: the gym!

videos.title: Sharko's Best Friend
videos.overview: An alien called Blobi turns up an onboard ship to enjoy himself. Sharko thinks he’s really cute and becomes great pals with him. But Blob is hungry, and when he’s hungry, he’ll eat anything, including mermaids… For once Zig is here to protect Marina!

videos.title: Zig's Shadow
videos.overview: When Bernie takes a photo of Zig with a strange camera, the shadow of the hyena comes to life. Completely independent of Zig, this creature will prove to be a precious ally for him and a real problem for Sharko...

videos.title: The Nap
videos.overview: Marina, Zig and Sharko go back to childhood remembering a famous afternoon nap by the water. Baby Marina is not sleepy and wants to fetch a mysterious object in the water while Baby Zig wants to make the mermaid her snack...

videos.title: Sink or Swim
videos.overview: Marina signs up for a swimming race and takes Sharko as coach. Zig participates too but he is so bad that Bernie has to give him a serious boost. Objective: to win the race but above all to bite the siren...

videos.title: A Ball on the Loose
videos.overview: Marina and Sharko try to catch and return a ball to two kids after it starts bouncing all over the ship, but Zig's attempts to eat Marina get in the way.

videos.title: A Castle Built for Two
videos.overview: Night has fallen over the ship. Bernie and the Starfish are finally alone together. They hope to spend a romantic night in their little castle, but it turns out to be more complicated than planned when Marina, Zig and Sharko decide to join them.

videos.title: The Serenade
videos.overview: As Marina prepares to fall asleep, Sharko comes to serenade under her windows, hoping for a kiss. But Zig and Bernie take the opportunity to sabotage his performances in order to climb to the balcony in his place and be able to eat the mermaid...

videos.title: Best Girlfriends
videos.overview: Zig disguises herself as a little girl and leads Marina into activities "forbidden to boys" to keep her away from Sharko. The shark would not only like to play with them, but also protect Marina. What if he too became his best friend?

videos.title: My Buddy Bigfoot
videos.overview: The ship stops on the Arctic Circle, where Zig meets a Bigfoot! The snow creature thinks Zig is just too cute and adopts him as a pet toy. Zig tries to train his new buddy to demolish Sharko, but Bigfoot’s not super smart…

videos.title: A Brother's Tiff
videos.overview: Zig and Bernie get confused. Bernie, annoyed, refuses to speak to the hyena. Zig wants to prove that he can manage on his own. Affected by the situation, Sharko and Marina will put in place a plan to reconcile the brothers...

videos.title: The Diving Contest
videos.overview: Zig and Sharko have signed up for a driving contest. The winner gets to dine privately with Captain Marina! But when Sharko reaches the diving board, he realizes that he’s scared to death of heights.

videos.title: The Elevator Trip
videos.overview: Zig and Marina get stuck inside the elevator together, so the former tries to take the opportunity to eat the latter, but his claustrophobia gets the better of him. Meanwhile, Sharko and Bernie team up to save the mermaid and the hyena.

videos.title: Childhood Treasure
videos.overview: Marina refuses to hang out with Sharko after he accidentally breaks her favorite music box, so he must get her a new one before Zig eats her first.

videos.title: Foggy Day
videos.overview: Bernie creates a device that buries the ship in a thick mist, so Zig can catch Marina without Sharko seeing him.

videos.title: The Rival
videos.overview: A big, new handsome shark comes aboard! Competition, based on mutual jealousy, soon develops between Sharko and Sharky. But when Marina is in danger, the sharks rise above their rivalry to join forces against Zig, to save her.

videos.title: Sharko on Ice
videos.overview: During a stopover on the ice, Sharko thinks of sharing a romantic moment with Marina by inviting her to dance as a duo on the ice. But the shark turns out to be a poor skater and Zig an ace on the ice...

videos.title: The Mime
videos.overview: A mime follows Sharko, publicizing his upcoming show onboard the ship. Sharko gets very annoyed, and ends up knocking the guy out by accident… This means he has to replace the mime in the show, along with Zig…

videos.title: Mobilemania
videos.overview: Sharko is addicted to Marina's cell phone. Zig and Bernie order one, just to work Marina quietly. Conquered by his "precious" laptop, the shark will have to make a choice: his laptop or the beautiful mermaid...

videos.title: Banana Peel
videos.overview: Zig and Bernie find a crate filled with bananas in the hold of the boat. This is the perfect accessory for setting ever more slippery traps in Sharko. It is best to be vigilant before putting any toes on the bridge...

videos.title: Saturday Night Dance
videos.overview: Sharko is looking forward to the cruise ship’s bell, so he can finally dance the tango with Marina… but Zig takes advantage of the party and use crazy dances to approach the mermaid discreetly.

videos.title: The Clairvoyant
videos.overview: When the strange tortoises tell Sharko and Marina a bad story, Sharko is afraid that it will happen.

videos.title: Lost at Sea
videos.overview: During a fight, Zig and Sharko tumble into a lifeboat. The lifeboat breaks off from the ship and falls into the water. Before they know it, they’re adrift in the ocean! Can they overcome past differences to survive… and get back on the cruise boat?

videos.title: The Power of the Cape
videos.overview: Zig is stealing a mysterious cape from Hades, which has magical power. A new trick to go after Marina the mermaid as she was spending a lovely evening with Sharko looking at the stars.

videos.title: The Rare Bird
videos.overview: Marina and a little reassured Sharko disembark on the island for a night excursion in search of a mysterious bird: the Kakaput. But Zig and Bernie intend to exploit the Sharko's and take the opportunity to work the siren...

videos.title: Deafening Noise
videos.overview: Sharko's hearing becomes highly sensitive after an accident involving the ship's horn, which proves to be a useful weakness to Zig.

videos.title: Daddy Bernie
videos.overview: Bernie invents a device to change Sharko into a baby, so Zig can devour the defenseless mermaid. But his experiment goes wrong and Bernie ends up having to deal with three babies: Sharko, Marina, and Zig! Will he be able to cope with this situation?

videos.title: A Pearl for my Girl
videos.overview: Sharko decides to offer a giant and sparkling pearl to Marina, hoping to win her heart. But Zig and Bernie work out the most cunning plans possible to steal the pearl and prevent Sharko from giving her his precious gift.

videos.title: The Boating License
videos.overview: After yet another liner accident, Marina decides to undergo accelerated-training for pilot Aldo.  Sharko ensures the safety of the course because Zig takes every opportunity to try to delight the siren.

videos.title: North Pole Movie
videos.overview: While on a port-of-call in the Antarctic, Marina wants to make a documentary about penguins. Sharko is her production assistant but can’t stand the cold. Zig plays this to his advantage to try and catch the mermaid.

videos.title: A Pie Dream
videos.overview: After accidentally taking a cream pie in the face, Sharko is at a low point. He dozes off and has dreams as far-fetched as each other ... Dreams that will help him free himself from the trauma of his childhood.

videos.title: Wide Awake
videos.overview: Sharko, after a good day, is about to fall into a restful sleep. But Zig and Bernie take pleasure in spoiling his night. In the early hours, Sharko did not close his eyes and was exhausted. Difficult to watch over Marina in this state!

videos.title: A Heroic Tale
videos.overview: Sharko, Zig and Bernie remember the time their boat almost sank when it hit a rock. Obviously Sharko says he saved the liner... But now, no one has the same version of the story and all declare  themselves as the hero of that day.

videos.title: Replicas
videos.overview: Bernie invented a machine capable of creating plastic clones from real characters. Everyone will be entitled to his double. Could this be the winning strategy to trick Sharko and crunch the mermaid?

videos.title: Mechanical Jaws
videos.overview: Zig and Bernie tinker with a box that allows them to control Sharko's jaw. The shark then involuntarily attacks Marina. Sharko does not understand what is happening to him, and fights against his dentures to save the mermaid!

videos.title: The Crosswalk
videos.overview: Sharko tries to help an elderly turtle cross a road, but Zig and Bernie don't make it easy for him.

videos.title: The Cloud
videos.overview: An evil lightning bolt strikes the ship’s clock and puts it out of joint. Time accelerates. All the ship’s passengers suddenly grow old. When Bernie tries to repair the clock, he inverses the process: everyone on board turns into a baby…

videos.title: The Captain's Evening
videos.overview: Marina prefers stargazing to the Captain's Gala evening.

videos.title: Game Over
videos.overview: Sharko is determined to defeat the final boss on an old arcade game, but Zig's constant attempts to eat Marina prevent him from doing so.

videos.title: Titazig
videos.overview: Sharko wants to recreate a romantic scene with Marina from the movie “Titanic” on the ship’s top deck, whereas Zig and Bernie aim to recreate the shipwreck scene, take advantage of the chaos and nab the mermaid…

videos.title: Poseidon's Visit
videos.overview: Poseidon wants Marina to marry a merman, so Zig disguises himself as one to get close to her.

videos.title: If the Shoe Fits (Part 1)
videos.overview: A magic fish enchants a pair of sandals that when worn by Marina gives her legs that are also enchanted.

videos.title: If the Shoe Fits (part 2)
videos.overview: Marina instantly gets used to her new enchanted legs making it difficult for Sharko to keep up with her giving Zig the opportunity to catch Marina.

videos.title: Shoe Fly
videos.overview: Zig Plans to use the magic sandals to catch Marina.

videos.title: Tough as Nails
videos.overview: When Sharko gets brand new nails, he must choose between his new nails or saving Marina from Zig.

videos.title: Patching Things Up
videos.overview: After Marina causes a giant hole to appear in the beach, she and Sharko uses different methods to patch the hole up but Zig and Bernie keep getting in the way.

videos.title: Don't Tell Dad
videos.overview: When her father Poseidon visits, Marina and Sharko try to keep the magic sandals a secret from him.

videos.title: Wacky Wand
videos.overview: Zig is given his own magic wand in which his used to try to catch Marina.

videos.title: Marina To The Rescue
videos.overview: Marina becomes the new hero on the beach causing Sharko to doubt himself, but it's all part of Zig's latest plan to catch Marina.

videos.title: Stradding The Equator
videos.overview: When Marina dreams of wanting to explore the island like the wild west, Zig and Sharko use a horse costume to make Marina's dream a reality.

videos.title: Stinky Slides
videos.overview: Sharko and Zig work together to get Marina to give the sandals a bath after they develop a nasty smell.

videos.title: Freewheeling
videos.overview: When Sharko tries to teach Marina rollerblade safety, Zig does awesome tricks to distract her in his latest plan to catch her.

videos.title: Shark Bitten
videos.overview: When he sees that Sharko gets a allergic reaction after getting bitten, Zig has the Fairy Godfish turn him into a mosquito.

videos.title: A Close Shave
videos.overview: Bernie creates a formula that causes hair to grow on Sharko.

videos.title: Shuffle Slides
videos.overview: Marina takes up irish step dancing and Zig decides to use it in his latest plan to catch her.

videos.title: What Were You Expecting?
videos.overview: In his latest plan to eat Marina, Zig dresses up as a pregnant woman and Sharko who's onto his plan does the same.

videos.title: It Wasn't Me!
videos.overview: When Poseidon shrinks Zig and puts him in a bottle after Sharko blames him for breaking a statue, Bernie and Marina work together to free Zig from his bottle prison, but Sharko ruins their attempts whe he fears that Zig will eat Marina once she frees him.

videos.title: Not Without My Slides
videos.overview: When a restaurant bans Marina because of the sandals, Zig and Bernie decides to put up various signs to ban Sharko.

videos.title: Head In The Clouds
videos.overview: When Marina loses a kite, she gets help from a cloud to get it back but it's being controlled by Zig and Bernie.

videos.title: Match Point
videos.overview: Marina and Sharko play a game of volleyball, but when Zig and Bernie join, it turns into a competition.

videos.title: Slide Show
videos.overview: Marina uses one of her legs like a sock puppet to entertain Sharko, but he soon gets annoyed by it.

videos.title: The Slide Trail
videos.overview: While kickboxing Marina by accident loses one of the sandals, so she and Sharko go into the jungle to search for it.

videos.title: The Last Yoghurt
videos.overview: When Bernie takes a picture of Sharko supposedly eating the last yoghurt he tries to prevent Marina from seeing it.

videos.title: Clowning Around
videos.overview: After discovering that Sharko is afraid of clowns, Zig has himself and Marina look like clowns in his latest plan to eat her.

videos.title: Sharko-Sapiens
videos.overview: Marina brings back from the ice a prehistoric shark which is none other than Sharko's ancestor. Hungry, the latter wants to eat Zig, it really suits Sharko who can finally rest for five minutes and let his ancestor do his job.
